scope: Draft notices from pinned Bun build sources across platforms. This is not a complete native or transitive inventory. Platform-specific binary coverage, source/relink delivery, embedded models and legal approval remain UNVERIFIED. Rust crate notices include the pinned workspace lockfile inventory, potentially including test or unused dependencies; this is not proof of per-platform binary inclusion. The initial filename scan missed ten crate notices: eight now have exact-source-revision supplements, r-efi uses its packaged AUTHORS permission text, and selectors uses its original source notice plus the referenced canonical MPL text. Source availability and legal acceptance remain unverified. Browser polyfill notices follow the pinned node-fallbacks lockfile, not a final bundle graph. Nine packages lack standalone root license files; their original complete README license sections are included with archive, source-file and byte-range provenance.
correspondingSource:
The engine and sk executables are Bun 1.4.5 standalone executables: the Bun runtime (revision a7733435cf40429e3b35c36072769df2052b80f1) followed by the SubKit application bundle. Bun is MIT-licensed; it statically links JavaScriptCore and WebKit (LGPL-2) and tinycc (LGPL-2.1).

Source of the LGPL components and the runtime:
- Bun: https://github.com/oven-sh/bun/tree/a7733435cf40429e3b35c36072769df2052b80f1
- WebKit fork (JavaScriptCore): https://github.com/oven-sh/WebKit/tree/d6375c72affe0f70222cdcb45012b10f0bf3a9d5
- tinycc fork: https://github.com/oven-sh/tinycc/tree/05f0fafaa3be31e31d7b4b5c17dc60f62c991171

To relink with a modified library:
1. Check out Bun at revision a7733435cf40429e3b35c36072769df2052b80f1 and its WebKit fork at the revision above, then build Bun as described in the Bun LICENSE.md below (bun sync-webkit-source, bun run build:local) and in Bun's contributing guide (https://bun.sh/docs/project/contributing).
2. Rebuild SubKit with that bun binary from the SubKit source: the pinned Bun version is in .bun-version; run bun install --frozen-lockfile, bun run build:cockpit, bun run build:clipper and bun scripts/fetch-embedding-assets.ts, then bun build apps/engine/src/index.ts and apps/sk/src/index.ts with --compile --external cpu-features exactly as in the SubKit Dockerfile.

Written offer: for at least three years after this release is distributed, the SubKit maintainers provide on request the complete corresponding source of these LGPL components together with the SubKit source and build scripts needed to relink, for no more than the cost of physically performing the distribution. Send the request through the contact form at https://subkit.mikebild.dev/kontakt. Once the SubKit repository is public, these sources will also be linked from it.
